Team — forwarding final customer confirmation and signed SOW. High level context and asks below. Please see attached SOW and the network diagram we received from Orchid.

Why this one matters: Orchid is an early-adopter health-tech customer with PHI transport needs; theyre contracting for Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPUs) with a 6-month commit. Theyll require VPC peering and SOC 2 evidence for procurement. Pricing includes a 15% implementation credit applied to onboarding hours.

Customer asks / constraints:
- Go-live target: 2027-01-10 (engineering wants earlier if possible).
- Wants sprint 0 compressed to 2 weeks; willing to accept a phased launch (core chat in week 1, embeddings/rerank in week 2).
- Kevin Liu will own network-side; Liz will own product acceptance.
- Point-of-contact for feature QA: Sarah Patel (sarah.p@orchidhealth.com) — she may join sprint ceremonies.

What I need from you (priority order):
1) Vivek: confirm whether sprint 0 can be condensed to 2 weeks with the current staffing and what the trade-offs are (risk list + minimal acceptance criteria).
2) Tessa: assign a primary CS owner for the ongoing success relationship post-go-live and confirm success milestones for the first 90 days.
3) Mina (you): take lead on the handoff doc, roster, and the acceptance criteria we present to Orchid during sprint planning.

Please reply with owners and a short plan by EOD Monday (Nov 22). If any of these asks are blockers, flag immediately and Ill escalate.

Ben
